title: evaluations row (one criterion per row: metric or figure)
description: analysis proposes and updates, gyb approves, rejects and retires; an approved row that is updated goes back to proposed (03 L156). Field table 03 L158-172.

applies_to.description: free text, not parsed, but must name concrete programs or parameters (03 L164)

metrics_key.description: metric rows: one of metrics_key / code_path (03 L165)

code_path.description: metric rows: one of metrics_key / code_path, like analysis/common/metrics.py:accuracy; may not exist while proposed, must exist when approved (03 L166)

group_by.description: figure rows: a runs top-level field, config.<key>, or an approved metric criterion id (03 L167)

x.description: figure rows: same domain as group_by (03 L168)

y.description: figure rows: same domain as group_by (03 L169)

uses.description: figure rows: which metric criteria it uses (03 L170)

quote.description: gyb's words, required on the approve version; one quote may approve several rows (03 L172)

x-conditions.rule: group_by, x, y take values from: runs top-level field names, config.<key>, or an approved metric criterion id
